messages:
jamie (PM): Quick sync — we have 8 customer reports about degraded streaming on long responses and 2 feature asks for chunked suggestions. Proposal: prioritize the streaming perf bug (P1) for the next 2-week sprint and push the chunked-suggestions polish to follow-on. Thoughts?

rachel (Eng): Can we quantify impact and confirm regression? Are these from the latest runtime patch?

olivia (Support): 6 of the 8 tickets are enterprise Dedicated customers — hitting client timeouts around ~30s. One is clearly a long-seq workload. They called this out as an SLA risk.
achel (Eng): Quick triage: looks like a change in the runtime's KV cache eviction from the 2026-03-12 patch. I can reproduce locally with a long-prime prompt. Repro snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"rwinf-3b","input":"<long-context>...","stream":true}
```
Trace: kv-cache spikes then stall at token 512.

simon (QA): If we go bug-first, we need a perf baseline + canary. Estimate: 3 dev-days, 1 QA day, + perf job hookup.

jnoah (Design): Chunked suggestions polish improves UX but isn't blocking. If bug patch lands fast, we should surface a brief UX checklist so we don't accidentally regress streaming UX on canary.

jamie (PM): Plan suggestion:
1) Create hotfix branch and target the regression (rachel + simon)
2) Canary in Dedicated for the 6 affected customers (set traffic 5-10%)
3) Olivia drafts a customer-facing note (avoid the word 'regression')
Acceptance criteria: canary shows 95th pct streaming latency improvement and no increase in token error rate.

olivia (Support): I'll draft a short note: "We're rolling a targeted performance improvement to reduce timeouts for long responses; ETA for rollout is 48 hours with targeted canaries." Will tag legal for wording.

rachel (Eng): I'll open the hotfix PR and include the perf test in CI. Tagging the runtime owner.

simon (QA): I'll add a perf harness job that replays one of the customer's failing traces and measure 50/95/99 pct. Also smoke test for token integrity.

deploy-bot: New canary created: canary/streaming-fix (id: c-4821) — routing 7% traffic to Dedicated pool "dedicated-streaming-2".

jamie (PM): Assigned: rachel (fix), simon (qa), olivia (comms). @noah please add UX checklist to the PR template. Sync in 30m to review PR + comms. :thumbsup:

noah (Design): Will add a 3-item checklist: "no UI stalls, partial tokens visible in streaming, and clear fallback messaging".

simon (QA): I'll post perf baselines to the console dashboard and pin them to the ticket.

jamie (PM): Good. If canary looks green by EOD we'll promote. If not, rollback and patch plan B. Recording this as the sprint commit decision. Thanks everyone.
